nodes.name: Applicability of the Companies Act
nodes.notes: M2 p.21 heading 'Applicability of the Companies Act, 2013 and key concepts' covers both this topic and 'Definitions and Key Concepts'. v0.2 DECISION: questions on STATUTORY COMPANIES (bodies constituted by a special Act, e.g. LIC) classify HERE at topic level. Evidence: M2 p.21 lists, under s.1(4), '(e) any other company governed by any special Act' and '(f) such body corporate, incorporated by any Act'; M2 p.55 (L2 Classification of Companies) defines statutory companies as constituted by a special Act, to which the Companies Act does not apply. Whether and how far the Act applies is the applicability question. No new node created.

nodes.name: Definitions and Key Concepts
nodes.notes: General s.2 definitions. v0.2 DECISION: questions on what a NIDHI COMPANY is classify HERE at topic level. Evidence: M2 p.24 lists 'Nidhi company: means a company which has been incorporated as a Nidhi ...' among the key definitions in this lesson. M2 has no Nidhi heading in L2, and no L02 bullet fits (DD-13). Nidhi-specific rules inside other topics (e.g. dividend cap p.363, notice p.543, s.108 e-voting exemption p.559) classify to that functional topic. No new node created.
